meta.parties: Dingiri Appu v. Punchi Appuhamy Et Al

rules.statement: A person who pays a debt on behalf of another, without being specifically mandated to do so, can claim contribution from the debtor in proportion to their liability.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the conditions are satisfied according to which the plaintiff must be regarded as negotiorum gestor in respect of these defendants who have not authorised the payment of the debt. There is evidence in the case, that one defendant, the second defendant, was actually present at the time of the payment, and approved, of the payment."
